name: @5dive/browser-plugin
description: Dependencies of `5dive browser`'s executor. The plugin itself is bash; this file exists only so the driver's Playwright is PINNED rather than resolved to whatever the box happened to have.
_comment: EXACT version, no caret. The driver speaks CDP to a Chrome holding a human's live session: a silent minor bump changes the launch arguments and the connection shape under a credential, and the failure would surface as 'the publish stopped working' on a customer box. Bump it deliberately, with the harness re-run.
